notes: Quantity/value contracts in SAP live in EKKO/EKPO with document category 'K' -- the same tables purchase orders use, distinguished by BSTYP. Header-only fields are mapped here; contract item data (release orders against the contract, target quantities per item) would need a K-targets EKPO leg once the business confirms whether Total_Value is a header aggregate or should be distributed to items. DATE-ORDER CAVEAT (from DATA_QUALITY_FINDINGS.md): 3 of 20 rows have End_Date before Start_Date (VC-2025-00007, VC-2025-00012, VC-2025-00014). The transform passes both dates through verbatim -- KDATB/KDATE are emitted exactly as the source states, with no 'correction' -- because guessing which date is wrong would fabricate data. SAP would reject these three at load; they need business review of the source records before a real load. NULL-VENDOR CAVEAT: rows 1 and 3 (VC-2025-00001, VC-2025-00003) have a null Vendor_ID in the source -- emitted as a null LIFNR (visible in the run-log null-rate section) rather than dropped, because silently losing rows would hide the defect; see DATA_QUALITY_FINDINGS.md.
